fr.answer_b: Dégonfler un peu le pneu pour effacer la bosse.

en.explanation: Since 1 April 2024, the green sticker and insurance card are no longer required for vehicles registered in France. Insurance remains compulsory; checks rely in particular on the Insured Vehicles Register (FVA).
